records.label: Complete blind-box figure display
records.image_promise: A complete collectible blind-box figure displayed against one clean solid backdrop, with a readable silhouette, smooth molded surfacing and soft product lighting.

staging.body_geometry: Use the figure's selected toy construction as connected molded masses, with compact proportions when the design chooses them and the full figure readable within the frame.
staging.action_geometry: The figure stands or holds a gently posed display configuration, maintaining its authored support and the shape relationships that identify the design.
staging.gaze_and_expression: Use the figure's selected expression and orientation; the display construction supplies no additional emotional or facial state.
staging.prop_or_contact_geometry: The figure rests on the plain display surface with coherent support and a subtle contact shadow. Any fixed carried component retains its authored connection.
staging.focal_hierarchy: The complete figure and its silhouette lead. Clean molded material groups keep the design readable across the visible surfaces.
staging.depth_order: The figure sits in front of one solid backdrop color, with the supporting plane indicated by its soft ground shadow.
staging.lighting_geometry: Soft even studio illumination describes the molded volumes with broad highlights and a subtle ground shadow.

defaults.subject: one collectible figure of the selected character design
defaults.body: the selected connected toy construction with smooth vinyl-like surfaces
defaults.composition: the whole figure inside the frame with crisp silhouette readability
defaults.camera: a display view that presents the figure's selected orientation without losing its complete extent
defaults.lighting: soft even studio light and a subtle ground shadow
defaults.constraints: molded material continuity, complete display coverage and the selected character design

must_preserve: the whole figure stays inside the frame for this complete display
one solid backdrop color with a soft ground shadow
surfacing reads as smooth molded toy material across the selected skin, hair, clothing or other declared forms
specific_failure_modes: environmental clutter competing with the display
photoreal skin texture replacing the molded material
harsh single-direction shadows replacing the soft product illumination
failure_modes: photoreal skin texture breaking the toy read
records.adaptation_rules: Select this whole presentation when complete figure coverage, a plain backdrop and product lighting serve the work. For the molded surface alone, use rendering-molded-vinyl-surface with the current depiction.

search_terms.phrase: complete figure on a solid product backdrop

records.label: Cheerful kawaii character presentation
records.image_promise: A deliberately friendly kawaii character presentation combining rounded softened shapes, large friendly eyes, a bright sweet palette, simple clean detailing and an approachable expression.

staging.body_geometry: Develop the selected character with rounded softened forms and large readable eyes when those design choices are open or already adopted. Preserve the identifying connections and proportions selected for this design.
staging.action_geometry: Use the current selected activity or held pose as the connected construction; the friendliness is expressed through its authored response rather than a mandatory gesture.
staging.gaze_and_expression: Use the individual's concrete friendly expression, including the selected eye opening, gaze, mouth configuration and any other participating channels.
staging.prop_or_contact_geometry: Any selected prop or support remains connected at the actual contact and retains its scale within the chosen activity.
staging.focal_hierarchy: The friendly character read leads, with broad rounded shapes, clean details and the sweet color groups supporting that encounter.
staging.depth_order: Keep the current selected framing and spatial relationships legible through clean color grouping and simplified detail.

defaults.subject: a character whose selected design includes large friendly eyes
defaults.body: rounded softened shapes at the adopted proportions
defaults.pose: the selected activity or held configuration
defaults.composition: the chosen character relationship with clean visual hierarchy
defaults.camera: the view selected for that relationship
defaults.lighting: the selected light carried through a bright sweet palette
defaults.environment: the chosen setting or field at supporting detail
defaults.constraints: friendly character expression, rounded shapes and clean sweet color groups

must_preserve: the concrete friendly expression at the selected degree
specific_failure_modes: a newly invented face replacing a design without facial channels
unapproved changes to fixed eye size or structure
dark gritty treatment replacing the selected bright sweet presentation
muddy color groups obscuring the clean design
failure_modes: sharp aggressive shapes replacing the selected soft shape language
muddy desaturated color flattening the chosen cheer
records.adaptation_rules: This is a whole character-presentation proposal. Choose it within the design and performance authority available. For only the shape-transition, palette and detail treatment while retaining another expression, use aesthetic-touch-kawaii-finish.
